visual_brief.subject: One underlying model is routed through two different access and safeguard tiers
verified_context: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 use the same underlying model.
Fable is broadly available with cyber and biology safeguards, while Mythos is available through verified programs for higher-risk work.
The release also adds standard and fast modes with different price and latency trade-offs; performance claims remain first-party.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: One central engine routes into two equal but differently gated chambers.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A single dark circular engine feeds a broad sage chamber and a narrower terracotta-edged verified chamber.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant and legible, but the literal padlock weakens the editorial abstraction.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant, yet the instruments and lock make the access split overly literal and visually busy.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. One central engine and two physically distinct chambers communicate shared capability with different access tiers at thumbnail scale.
